question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
Here, we use the tables given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24bf74eaab250e33759da1963f417d167d35d069057bead0f90cfe6bc621939b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd152feed076a5a0b1fce978a393ef5c831c7c37a769d7359c7cd1401be10364.png] 

**Logic:** The second letter is the opposite letter of the first number and (4) is added to the position value of the first letter to get the third letter.

**1.** CXG →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a0c0598b0b9279342e29c1fd4674c35b660112f9c6130658aaf1cf1299fce28.png] 

**2.**IRM →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d02891c35fc3290bca3b4db70644bfb588495e183bf90482a9a9f09861036f.png] 

**3. **BYF →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ec114e58037c89ecfea0fe9ab299b44181ff087759cc9d177d71e4ad9c8f58e.png] 

**4. GUK →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d69348241c455c16786c1df5de8ac4bba469201324babadb1c4afffd3af38815.png] 

Here, in **'GUK'** different logic is followed.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
